message.content: {"note_claim": "The first plane strike on the World Trade Center was not broadcast live; it was captured by French filmmaker Jules Naudet while filming a documentary and aired later.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Jules captured the clearest footage of the first airplane, American Airlines Flight 11, hitting the North Tower of the World Trade Center when he rode with Battalion 1 to investigate a suspected gas leak", "reason": "The page confirms Jules Naudet filmed the first impact while making a documentary about the FDNY, and that the footage was later made into the 2002 documentary 9/11, though it does not explicitly say the impact was not broadcast live."}

parsed.note_claim: The first plane strike on the World Trade Center was not broadcast live; it was captured by French filmmaker Jules Naudet while filming a documentary and aired later.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Jules captured the clearest footage of the first airplane, American Airlines Flight 11, hitting the North Tower of the World Trade Center when he rode with Battalion 1 to investigate a suspected gas leak
